rationale: The DMARC enforcement gap is extensively documented across a decade of DNS research, multiple competitor products charging real money, and recurring community complaints — confirming both pain frequency and willingness to pay. At least five distinct signals confirm the fear-of-breaking-email barrier, and three paid competitors (Dmarcian, Valimail, EasyDMARC) with published pricing provide hard willingness-to-pay evidence. Target audience (IT/email admins) is specific and reachable.
